lines.en: I drag my shell through the shallows.
The reef cracks when I hit it.
Eight legs tread the wet mud.
Seaweed clings to my shell.
I shift step by step through the fog.
I follow the tide line inland.

lines.zh: 水里我更快，但也得上岸。
lines.en: Faster in water, but I must come ashore.
My shell is harder than stone.
The Seaborn column is ahead.

lines.zh: 每一步都碾碎一片地衣。
lines.en: Every step crushes a patch of lichen.

lines.zh: 我嗅着空气里的血味走。
lines.en: I walk toward the blood smell.
Land is dry; I dislike it.
I squeeze sideways through the fissure.
My claws dig into the mud.

lines.zh: 礁岸的碎屑在我脚下响。
lines.en: Reef rubble crunches under me.
I slowly turn my body.
I lie low on the reef.
Seawater drips from my shell's seams.
I wait for prey to pass.
Fog clings to my shell.
Something living is in the air.
Still, my shell looks like rock.
My tendrils sway in the water.

lines.zh: 体内有东西在慢慢变化。
lines.en: Something inside me keeps changing.
I count the tide's rhythm.
This tidal flat belongs to the Seaborn.
I lower my mandibles.
Someone is moving far off.
I'm slow enough to look harmless.
Blood flows slow beneath my shell.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我隔着壳都听得见。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat even through my shell.

lines.zh: 我认得陆地生物的呼吸。
lines.en: I know how land things breathe.

lines.zh: 你站的地方已经归我了。
lines.en: Where you stand is already mine.

lines.zh: 我的壳会把你的刀弹开。
lines.en: My shell will turn your blade.
Can you count my legs?
I'm calm; prey should be too.
The Seaborn's will pushes me.
Where would you run?
We are always evolving.

lines.zh: 你的喘气声越来越急了。
lines.en: Your breathing quickened.
My shell cracked.
Blood wells from the seam.
I retreat toward the water.
That hit an old wound.
One leg spasms.
I bear the pain and keep moving.
The Seaborn won't withdraw for this.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我还站得稳。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; I still stand firm.
This body can still be repaired.
Not enough.
That thing has flesh in it.
Drop it and go; don't look back.
I'm not picky; live is better.
That smell tightens my forelegs.

lines.zh: 你以为我会为这个停下？
lines.en: You think that would stop me?
A little is enough.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，你还有时间跑。
lines.en: I approach slowly; you still have time to run.
Food is scarcer in the sea.
I open my mandibles.
Drop it and go.
You struck my shell.
I don't shift at all.
You were thrown back two steps.
My legs held.
Don't walk pressed against me.
That impact isn't enough.
You stepped on my claw tip.
We're both hard, but you have no shell.
You sank deeper into the mud.
Again and it's the same.
Seaborn breeding doesn't work that way.
We split from tissue.

lines.zh: 这不过是陆地生物的习惯。
lines.en: That's just a land creature's habit.
This body isn't suited.

lines.zh: 我的种群里没有伴侣二字。
lines.en: In my swarm there is no word for mate.
I don't understand your meaning.
I need no mate.
We evolve; we don't pair.

lines.zh: 我的下颚可不是用来亲近的。
lines.en: My mandibles aren't made for closeness.
Withdraw.
I'll drag this tissue back under the reef.
I pin it with a claw.
Shelled things keep better.

lines.zh: 有营养的，我压在壳底下。
lines.en: Anything nourishing goes under my shell.
Whose tissue is this?
Take it back to the nest.
I drag it away slowly.
Worthless, but edible.
It dissolves in my grip.
Leaving a trace is enough.
I smell your blood.

lines.zh: 你踏进礁岸，就归我管了。
lines.en: Step onto my reef shore and you're mine.
I lower down, forelegs taut.

lines.zh: 你走进我的索敌范围了。
lines.en: You've entered my hunting range.

lines.zh: 这一击要压碎你的骨头。
lines.en: This blow will crush bone.
The Seaborn's will points at you.
I need no voice.
Don't try to reach high ground.
I can reach you from here.

lines.zh: 你脚陷住了，正好给我机会。
lines.en: Your feet are stuck — just the opening I need.
I follow your footprints.

lines.zh: 八条腿轮着落，慢慢收口。
lines.en: Eight legs step in turn, closing the ring.

lines.zh: 我的腿在泥里更容易走。
lines.en: My legs move better in mud.
I'll drive you toward the water.
Every time you turn, there I am.
My shell doesn't tire.
The fog hides me better.
Further on is a dead end.
You're panting.
I'm waiting for you to step wrong.
Mandibles clamp down.
A foreleg slams down.
Shell against flesh; you lose.

lines.zh: 这一钳下去，铁片也得弯。
lines.en: One clamp of these and even iron bends.
I tear an opening.
The smell of blood thickens.
You were knocked back three blocks.
Once more and bones break.
I'm behind you.
Do not struggle.
I rise from the deep water.
The tide pushed me ashore.
The air is too dry.
My shell is still wet.
The smell of reef rock is familiar.
The people here haven't noticed.
My legs unfold one by one.
I hear the sounds of land.
Let me adjust to this place.
The evolution continues.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，壳面起泡。
lines.en: Fire roasts my shell; it blisters.
I fell off the reef into the shallows.
Too much water can kill me too.
The blast flipped me over.
Something stuck in my shell's gap.
That force churned my insides.
My tissue begins to consume itself.

lines.zh: 雷穿过湿壳，我浑身僵住。
lines.en: Lightning crossed my wet shell; I froze.
No water beneath me, no ground either.
